Title: CDN – Standard and Premium CDN tiers available

Body.Content:
We’ve unveiled new Standard and Premium feature sets for CDN customers.
  • The Standard functionality contains the CDN functionality you’re already familiar with, including integration with a number of origin types, query string caching, and custom domain name support.
  • The Premium tier includes all the functionality of the Standard tier, and adds a rules-based content delivery engine, advanced HTTP reports, and real-time statistics.
For a complete breakdown of the features available in each tier, see Overview of the Azure Content Delivery Network.
